notes: No fiction found to remove; kept real cultivar/brand names (tigger melon, Santa Claus melon, Cinderella pumpkin, SweeTango, Velveeta, Humboldt Fog). No digit-containing members found worth adding. nduja changed to 'nduja (leading apostrophe, the Italian name); revert to nduja if a leading apostrophe on a balloon looks wrong. Left plain where English dictionaries do: weisswurst, jicama, matzo, croque monsieur, oeufs en cocotte, Port Salut, cep. Separate rationale: apple varieties (Rome, Jazz, Empire), nuts (different category), mushrooms (button, oyster, hedgehog, parasol do not read as vegetables), andean crops (quinoa, coca, cherimoya are not vegetables), seafood dishes / barbecue foods / egg dishes / cheese dishes (dishes and sides, not ingredients), butcher shop (place objects), types of milk (whole, oat, rice, raw meaningless alone), cheesemaking words (wheel, press, cave, starter). Pre-existing oddity not changed: vegetables lists eggplant and aubergine as separate entries (and squashes zucchini/courgette) rather than using the uk field.
